name: Terminal Block Cover
description: 90 x 30 x 25 mm U-channel cover for a terminal strip: 2 mm walls, two screw flanges, and five ventilation slots in the roof.

steps.instruction: Create the cover blank: a solid block 90 mm long (X), 30 mm wide (Y) and 25 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.

transcript.user_prompt: Create the cover blank: a solid block 90 mm long (X), 30 mm wide (Y) and 25 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the solid 90 x 30 x 25 mm blank the cover is hollowed from.

steps.instruction: Hollow the cover from below: cut an 86 x 26 mm pocket from under the base up to Z=23, leaving 2 mm walls and a 2 mm roof, open at the bottom.

transcript.user_prompt: Hollow the cover from below: cut an 86 x 26 mm pocket from under the base up to Z=23, leaving 2 mm walls and a 2 mm roof, open at the bottom.
transcript.assistant_message: I hollowed the blank from underneath into an inverted-U channel — 2 mm walls and roof, open at the bottom to drop over a terminal strip.

steps.instruction: Add a screw flange at each end: tabs 10 mm long (X), 20 mm wide (Y, centered) and 3 mm thick, on the base plane at X = +/-50 (flush against the end walls).

transcript.user_prompt: Add a screw flange at each end: tabs 10 mm long (X), 20 mm wide (Y, centered) and 3 mm thick, on the base plane at X = +/-50 (flush against the end walls).
transcript.assistant_message: I added the two 20 mm wide screw flanges at the ends of the cover, flush with the base so it can be fastened down.

steps.instruction: Drill an M3 clearance hole of radius 1.7 mm through each flange at (X, Y) = (+/-50, 0).

transcript.user_prompt: Drill an M3 clearance hole of radius 1.7 mm through each flange at (X, Y) = (+/-50, 0).
transcript.assistant_message: I drilled the 3.4 mm screw holes through both flanges — the cover fastens with two M3 screws.

steps.instruction: Cut five ventilation slots through the roof: each slot 2 mm wide (X) by 16 mm long (Y), centered in Y, at X = -16, -8, 0, 8 and 16.

transcript.user_prompt: Cut five ventilation slots through the roof: each slot 2 mm wide (X) by 16 mm long (Y), centered in Y, at X = -16, -8, 0, 8 and 16.
transcript.assistant_message: I cut the five 2 x 16 mm vent slots through the roof at 8 mm pitch so heat from the terminals can escape.
